name: The native bug report request is answered through the bug tracker packets
contract: C_BugTracker.SubmitReport sends CMSG_CREATE_BUG_REPORT (0x0562): u32 realm field, u32 category, u32 priority, u8 public, then the title and description as a u32 length and bytes. The server answers every request with SMSG_CREATE_BUG_REPORT_ERROR (0x0565) or SMSG_CREATE_BUG_REPORT_SUCCESS (0x0566). A report marked private is refused whether or not CoABugReport is enabled (disabled realm or public-issue refusal), so it never reaches the spool; a truncated request is refused as invalid.
